how.h2: From idea to a working team in

steps.title: Define your agents
steps.body: In Agent Studio, give each agent a name, a role, a personality and the tools they need. Like writing a job description — your agent remembers it forever.

steps.title: Compose your team
steps.body: In Team Studio, drag agents onto your canvas. Choose a topology — Group Chat, Manager-Led, Hierarchical. Structure your team like a real org.

steps.title: Run or automate
steps.body: Launch your team for dynamic collaboration — or build a deterministic workflow that runs the same way, every single time. You choose the mode that fits the job.

studios.sub: Whether you're defining an agent, organising a team, or automating a process — there's a studio for that.

cards.title: Define your agents
cards.body: Name, role, tools, instructions, personality. Configure each agent once — then reuse them across any team or workflow.

cards.title: Organise your team
cards.body: Drag agents onto a visual canvas. Connect them. Choose a topology that defines authority, collaboration style and delegation. Like drawing an org chart — that actually works.

cards.title: Automate your processes
cards.body: Build step-by-step workflows that run exactly the same way, every time. Sequential nodes, conditional branches, scheduled runs. Deterministic by design.

topologies.sub: Most tools pass data between steps. Agentivity gives each agent a role, an authority level, and a real collaboration structure. Your agents don't just receive instructions — they know their place in the team, who they report to, and how decisions get made. Not wired. Organised.
topologies.diff: Not task routing. Real team structure.

items.name: Group Chat
items.body: Everyone contributes — freely, openly, building on each other's ideas. Like a brainstorm where the best thinking wins, not the loudest voice.

items.name: Manager-Led
items.body: One agent leads, coordinates and delegates. Tasks flow down, results flow up. Your virtual project manager — without the status updates.

items.name: Hierarchical
items.body: Clear chain of authority. Each level approves before the next begins. Built for quality control, multi-stage review, and compliance-sensitive workflows.

items.name: Sequential
items.body: One after another. Reliable, auditable, always the same. The backbone of your repeatable, scheduled business processes.

workflow_studio.h2_accent: Workflows when you need your own rules.
workflow_studio.sub: Some tasks cannot afford variation. A weekly report. A client deliverable. A compliance check. A content pipeline. In Workflow Studio, you define the process exactly — every step, every branch, every output format. Your agents follow it to the letter. No improvisation. No interpretation. Just results.

points.title: Guaranteed output
points.body: You define what you'll receive. Your agents deliver exactly that — every run, without exception. Same structure, same format, same quality.

points.title: Scheduled or triggered
points.body: Run every Monday at 6am, on a file upload, on a webhook. Your workflow starts exactly when you need it — without you lifting a finger.

points.title: Fully auditable
points.body: Every step logged, every decision traceable. Know exactly what ran, when, and why — and prove it when it counts.

cells.label: Integrations
cells.headline: Connects to your existing stack
cells.body: Your agents work inside the tools you already use. Slack, Gmail, HubSpot, Notion, Google Sheets, WordPress — your team plugs in and gets to work. No rip-and-replace.

cells.label: You're in charge
cells.headline: You decide. Your team executes.
cells.body: You set the brief. Your agents do the work. At any point, you can step in, redirect, or approve before anything goes out. Full autonomy when you want it. Full control when it counts.

cells.label: Always on
cells.headline: Runs 24/7 without you
cells.body: Schedule your team to run at night, on weekends, on a trigger. The result is waiting when you wake up.

cells.label: No-code
cells.headline: No technical skills needed
cells.body: If you can write a job description, you can brief an agent. Start from a template in minutes.

cells.label: For agencies
cells.headline: Build and sell as your own
cells.body: White-label Agentivity for your clients. Deliver AI team solutions under your brand. Open source, yours to extend.
